decision: Reviewed browser candidate ready for parent-owned deployment and supervised browser/robot verification. No new physical success claimed by offline tests.
problem: A model batch with forward0.15m/s then a turn could continue into the turn after the API refused the move: ordinary tool failures lack command_epoch_required, and the browser only fenced unknown/epoch failures. A separate five-tool Sit/wait/paws/stand batch could execute silently because whole-turn native narration was intentionally rejected and cached cues depended on that same model-output permission.
changes: A definitive failed action request pauses further model action requests, including later SDK packets, until explicit voice reconnect. PTT does not silently rearm. Stop/status remain possible; known status/auth-gate refusals alone do not trigger the new action fence.

If another model action is already in flight, false/unknown/malformed action outcome uses existing global Stop and shared HTTP epoch fencing. Disposed/disconnected old sessions cannot initiate a late global Stop. No failed action is retried.
Current known failure feedback stays visible; approved fixed failure audio can speak after the actual reply. Unknown, malformed, superseded or locally-unsent outcomes never use known-failure clips.

Fixed cached cues now depend on their own actual current server replies, independent of whether an arbitrary multi-tool model turn can be narrated. Queued cues require the typed queued marker. Whole-turn model narration remains gated and fourth-handshake composed joke remains on its exact native path.

Eight additional fixed Gemini Puck clips join the original four after explicit human listening approval:12total. Exact model/voice/PCM hash checks and existing bounded connection preload remain; cache misses fall back to the existing native receipt path. No OS voice or new motion command is introduced.

reproduction.actual_api_shape: In-process real HTTP routes with fake ROS: move(.15m/s) returned HTTP200success:false without epochflags; separately requested validturn returned queued success and produced7nonzero fake turn outputs. These are simulation harness outputs, not hardware.
reproduction.before_service: Same failed-move/turn callback and concurrent-action cases failed4of5 new tests on the pre-fix service; before source/log preserved.
reproduction.after_service: Actual production Live service under SDK mocks refuses the later turn and future model packets; actual RobotBridge fake-fetch regression verifies a delayed old-epoch turn is rejected after automatic Stop, with0fake turn effects.
reproduction.five_tool_audio: Actual approved12PCM cache loaded under production service; deferred replies prove each of5cues occurs only after its own accepted response. Arbitrary whole-turn model completion narration remains muted.

validation.independent_review: peer-review-r2.json includes final comment-only source correction; no executable changes after262fulltests.

human_audio_approval.scope: Approval of these exact12recorded fixed phrases and same-voice consistency, not every future generated utterance.
human_audio_approval.provenance: Synthetic fixed text via exact Gemini Live/Puck; PCM, WAV, provider transcript, generation scripts/logs, pending/approved manifests, hashes and human approval retained.

limitations: Voice control now requires reconnect after a failed action; no inference that previously accepted work had no effects.
Global Stop for overlapping failed requests cancels the whole queue; no per-job cancellation or universal immediate physical-stop proof.
Fixed cues say queued/requested/failed, not physically completed. Detailed refusal limits remain visible.
Whole-turn natural speech latency and transcript-versus-waveform uncertainty remain. No measured millisecond latency improvement from this patch.
No real Google request, microphone, speaker or robot motion was performed by the integration tests. Root owns actual browser/hardware follow-up.
English no-tool claim heuristic and downstream physical policy limitations remain; this is not a global foundation completion claim.
